result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked crosswalks but lacks pedestrian refuge islands or visible dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is dominated by vehicle-centric design with long crossing distances and minimal separation between the sidewalk and high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a midway refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection crossing the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: Crosswalk and lane markings are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint crosswalks with high-visibility 'continental' or 'ladder' style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time remaining.

result.summary: This is a car-oriented commercial intersection characterized by wide multi-lane roadways and incomplete pedestrian infrastructure. While a marked crosswalk and curb ramps are visible for the side entrance, the main thoroughfare lacks visible pedestrian crossings, creating significant exposure for anyone attempting to traverse the intersection.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The main roadway has at least four through lanes plus turn lanes, requiring pedestrians to cross a vast expanse of asphalt without a marked crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center across the main multi-lane road

hazards.name: High-Speed Slip Lane
hazards.description: A channelized right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk at the pedestrian crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection entering the commercial area

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks across the primary legs of the intersection forces pedestrians to cross unpredictably.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main road in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style high-visibility crosswalks across all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers and push buttons to provide dedicated crossing phases.

interventions.title: Corner Radius Reduction
interventions.description: Tighten the corner radii or remove the slip lane to slow down turning vehicles and shorten the crossing distance.

result.summary: The image shows a wide arterial road with multiple lanes and a large commercial parking lot. While marked crosswalks and a median refuge are present, the environment is hostile to pedestrians due to long crossing distances and high-speed design.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must traverse at least six lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Main arterial crossing in the center of the image.

hazards.name: High-Speed Road Geometry
hazards.description: Wide travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to reduce the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.
